Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

Court No. - 77
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 15832 of 2023

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 85 of 2022, under Section 376 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, P.S. Muhammadabad, District Ghazipur, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
3. It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.

The informant has lodged first information report on 08.04.2022,
alleging that on 04.04.2022 at 6.00 AM, the applicant has enticed away his 12 years old niece.

In her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., victim has stated that she used to talk with applicant and that applicant has enticed away by saying that he would marry with her and he took her to Ghajipur and Mithilesh Thakur vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129463437/
1 kept her there for four days and forcibly established physical relations with her and thereafter he has left her at Banaras railway station and ran away.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., victim has stated that her age is 12 years and on 04.04.2022 she was scolded by her parents and she has left her home and met with applicant, who took her to Ghazipur and they remained there for four days and later on they were going to Delhi but applicant has left her at Banaras railway station and ran away.
Learned counsel submitted that the allegations of rape made by the victim in her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., are wholly false.

In her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C.,
victim has not made any allegation against the applicant.
As per ossification report, the age of victim is about 19 years.
Her allegation of rape is not supported by her medical examination report.
It was submitted that the victim was having love affair with applicant and she has made allegations against the applicant under pressure of her family members.

Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 21.02.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate in the trial.
4. Learned A.G.A has opposed the prayer for bail and argued that the informant as well as mother of victim have stated that victim is a 12 years old and she was student of Class 7th.
The victim has also stated that her age is 12 years.
In her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she has made allegations of rape against the applicant.
She has also stated that applicant has left her at Banaras railway station and ran away.
As per school record, the date of birth of victim is 15.08.2009 and thus, at the time of alleged incident, she was aged less than 14 years.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, gravity of offence and all attending facts and circumstances of case, without expressing any opinion on merits,
at this stage the applicant is not entitled to be enlarged on bail. Hence, the bail application of applicant Mithilesh Thakur is hereby rejected.

Order Date :- 22.5.2023 A. Tripathi  Mithilesh Thakur vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129463437/
